beats.name: Awakening of the Ghungroo
beats.prompt: Gently lift your hand to bring Anarkali to life above the stage floor.

beats.name: The Royal Salaam
beats.prompt: Tilt your wrist forward to let her perform a deep courtly bow.

beats.name: The Dholak Rhythm
beats.prompt: Wiggle your fingers to the dholak beat to make her pleated skirt flare in dance.

beats.name: Chakkar (The Golden Spin)
beats.prompt: Twirl your hand in a fast circle to execute a rapid spin; shower of rose petals falls.

beats.name: Curtain Call of Honour
beats.prompt: Raise both hands high to greet the cheering audience as the velvet curtain falls.

meetTheMaker.title: Meet the Maker: The Bhat Puppeteer
meetTheMaker.description: Anarkali’s head was shaped with simple chisels from desert Rohida wood, then smoothed and painted with large almond eyes lined with kajal. Her multi-tiered rani-pink skirt has no legs underneath; the illusion of dance is born entirely from the momentum of pleated fabric weighted with pure gold gota ribbon at the hem.
meetTheMaker.communityDedication: Preserved by generations of the Bhat puppeteer families of Rajasthan.
